title: browser
description: Control the web browser (Chromium). open and navigate go to an address (http, https or file); back, forward and reload move through the history; click and type act on an element of the page; read returns the text of the page; ax_tree lists the elements of the page with ids (w1, w2, ...); tabs lists the open tabs and switch_tab makes one of them the current one.

url.description: The address, for open and navigate.

target.description: The element, for click and type: an id (w12) from ax_tree, or a CSS selector.

text.description: The text to type, for type; it replaces what the field holds.

tab.description: The tab's number as tabs lists it (from 1), for switch_tab.
